ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l’industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l’avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses quatre missions : former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l’innovation, en un cercle vertueux et porteur d’innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche place IMT Mines Albi comme une école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT : l’industrie du futur responsable ; l’énergie, l’économie circulaire et la société ; l’ingénierie, la santé et le bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s’est dotée en 2023, pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en sept grandes actions, répondant aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT auquel elle appartient.

 

IMT Mines Albi représente :

  • 985 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation ;

  • 300 personnels ;

  • un budget consolidé de 32 M€ ;

  • trois centres de formation et de recherche : Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A), RAPSODEE et Centre Génie Industriel.

 

 

Le Centre Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A) est un centre de formation et de recherche d’IMT Mines Albi. Il rassemble 70 personnes, dont 20 enseignants-chercheurs.

Au titre de la formation, il est un acteur de la formation ingénieur généraliste d’IMT Mines Albi, sous statut étudiant ou apprenti, et porte l’option « Matériaux et procédés avancés pour les transports de demain ».

 

Au titre de la recherche, il est partie intégrante de l’Institut Clément Ader (ICA – UMR CNRS 5312), laboratoire rassemblant 250 personnes et développant des thématiques scientifiques axées sur l’ingénierie et la mécanique des matériaux, notamment dans le domaine de l’aéronautique. Ses cinq établissements de tutelle sont l’INSA de Toulouse, l’ISAE-SUPAERO, l’Université Paul Sabatier, IMT Mines Albi et le CNRS.

 

Site Internet de l’ICA : https://ica.cnrs.fr/

 

L’ICA traite des études sur les structures, les systèmes et les processus mécaniques. Ses secteurs d’activité sont les industries mécaniques, avec un accent particulier sur l’aérospatiale, l’espace, le transport et l’énergie.

Le centre Institut Clément Ader Albi contribue aux quatre groupes de recherche de l’ICA :

  • Matériaux et Structures Composites ;

  • Surfaces, Usinage, Matériaux, Outillages ;

  • Métrologie, Identification, Contrôle, Surveillance ;

  • Modélisation des Systèmes et Microsystèmes Mécaniques.

 

Le champ d’action d’ICA-A est d’optimiser les outillages ou les procédés de mise en forme des matériaux (métaux, composites, polymères, verres, etc.) ainsi que d’étudier les relations entre microstructure, procédé et comportement, en particulier pour les secteurs de l’aéronautique et du spatial. Ses activités sont fortement expérimentales, mais également numériques.

 

ICA-A possède sa propre plateforme de recherche sur le campus d’IMT Mines Albi, la plateforme MIMAUSA. ICA-A est une Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR) depuis 2021.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

De manière générale, la personne recrutée participera aux projets pédagogiques de l’école, aux missions de formation, aux activités de recherche et de transfert de technologies, au montage et au suivi des activités contractuelles ainsi qu’aux collaborations nationales et internationales. Elle contribuera activement au développement de ces activités et pourra être amenée à exercer des responsabilités administratives et d’encadrement.

 

La personne recrutée aura notamment vocation à assurer :

 

  • des responsabilités pédagogiques : responsable de cycle d’enseignement, responsable d’option, responsable de Master ou Mastère, responsable d’unité d’enseignement ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités en recherche : directeur de centre, directeur de centre adjoint, responsable de groupe de recherche, responsable d’axe de recherche, responsable de plateforme ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités liées au transfert industriel et au développement économique ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités transverses, comme par exemple : responsable de processus ou sous-processus, responsable thématique international.

 

Activités de formation

Dans le programme de formation du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée participera aux activités pédagogiques et d’enseignement d’IMT Mines Albi.

 Dans ce cadre, elle sera amenée à :

  • contribuer à l’évolution des programmes pédagogiques et assurer des enseignements dans les domaines de l’analyse de données et de l’intelligence artificielle appliquées à l’écoconception, au développement de nouveaux matériaux, à leur mise en forme, ainsi qu’à l’étude de leurs mécanismes de dégradation et à la prévision de la durée de vie des pièces ;

  • accompagner et organiser les missions de formation de l’École sous leurs diverses formes : formation initiale ou continue, sous statut étudiant ou salarié, et formations débouchant sur des diplômes de Mastère ou de Master ;

  • participer au montage ou au pilotage de nouvelles formations (Mastère ou Master), prendre la responsabilité d’une ou plusieurs unités d’enseignement, s’impliquer dans l’organisation et le suivi de projets étudiants, ainsi que dans l’élaboration et l’exploitation de MOOC ;

  • encadrer des projets avec mises en situation, des stages et des travaux de fin d’études.

 

Activités de recherche

 Dans le programme de recherche du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée :

  • proposera une démarche scientifique pour le développement de méthodes innovantes d’exploitation et d’analyse de données et d’utilisation de l’IA, capables de répondre aux exigences d’un dialogue essais/calcul multi-échelles. Ces méthodes seront utilisées pour le suivi ou la compréhension des propriétés des matériaux en lien avec leur fabrication ou avec le suivi de l’état de santé de pièces en service dans des environnements potentiellement critiques (hautes ou basses températures, contraintes mécaniques fortes, atmosphères oxydantes ou corrosives) ;

  • sera rattachée à un des groupes de recherche du laboratoire ICA (UMR 5312)

  • devra démontrer sa capacité à développer une activité contractuelle avec les entreprises et à participer au montage de chaires d’enseignement et de recherche en relation avec les entreprises ;

  • contribuera au rayonnement scientifique d’IMT Mines Albi et du laboratoire ICA par une implication active dans l’encadrement de thèses et de post-doctorants, par une production scientifique significative, par la diffusion de l’information scientifique lors de conférences et par l’organisation de manifestations scientifiques ;

  • sera amenée à monter des projets collaboratifs en lien avec les autres centres de recherche d’IMT Mines Albi : RAPSODEE et CGI.

 

 

Activités de valorisation et de développement économique

Dans le programme de valorisation et de développement économique du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée devra :

  • renforcer le développement économique local et régional par l’accompagnement d’entités en incubation ou en prospection d’incubation au sein d’IMT Mines Albi ;

  • et/ou soutenir les initiatives ponctuelles en répondant aux demandes d’accompagnement (thèses CIFRE, contrats directs) formulées par les entreprises, en particulier les TPE et PME, dans son domaine d’expertise ;

  • et/ou accompagner la dynamique industrielle en s’impliquant dans la mise en place et le pilotage de chaires industrielles ou de laboratoires communs permettant d’optimiser le transfert technologique et méthodologique à destination des acteurs locaux, régionaux ou nationaux.

 

Évolution des responsabilités

À moyen terme, la personne recrutée pourra se voir proposer :

  • des responsabilités pédagogiques : responsable de cycle d’enseignement, responsable d’option, responsable de Master ou Mastère, responsable d’unité d’enseignement ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités en recherche : responsable de groupe de recherche, responsable d’axe de recherche, responsable de plateforme ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités liées au transfert industriel et au développement économique.

 

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

La personne candidate devra justifier d’une expérience d’au moins huit ans en recherche dans la spécialité Data/IA appliquée aux matériaux et procédés.

 

Une qualification aux fonctions de professeur en 60e section du CNU est fortement souhaitée.

 

En outre, la personne candidate devra :

 

  • présenter une expertise scientifique dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : jumeaux numériques, dynamique des systèmes, machine learning, deep learning, réseaux de neurones, deep optimisation ;

Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Contexte du stage

Depuis des années, Doctrine propose une fonctionnalité d’envoi de décision de justice en France à ses clients. Cela est une source précieuse de décisions de justice qui permet à Doctrine d’enrichir sa base de données (c'est-à-dire son legal graph) avec des décisions qui n’ont pas pu être ajoutées par nos processus habituels.

Le but de ce stage est l’internationalisation de cette fonctionnalité de manière à ce qu’elle soit utilisable dans tous les autres pays où Doctrine est actif (Italie, Allemagne).

Les tâches principales seront :
  • Le développement d’une application minimale pour la revue et validation des décisions de justice mises en ligne par nos utilisateurs pour nos juristes avant leur publication.
  • La migration du processus legacy d’upload français actuel pour se conformer au processus commun (internationalisé).
Une fois que le processus de mise en ligne de décisions par nos utilisateurs sera internationalisé, le ou la stagiaire pourra travailler sur des tâches d’amélioration de l’application de revue de décisions dans le but d’aider notre équipe de juristes à mieux traiter le volume de décisions mises en ligne.

Exemples de pistes d’amélioration (non exhaustif)
  • Application de techniques d’OCR sur les documents pour faciliter leur validation.
  • Détection via LLM d’attributs des décisions (niveau de confidentialité, juridiction, domaine du droit, cour, …) pour faciliter leur validation.
  • Aide au retrait de contenu qui n’est pas le texte de la décision (pages blanches, notification à l’avocat, …).
    Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la définition de la solution et sa réalisation. Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Italie et sera amené·e à travailler avec les équipes des autres pays (principalement l’équipe France) et l’équipe légale. Il ou elle participera aussi au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs full stack de l’entreprise).
 

Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Partner Marketing exists to fuel the growth and success of Wellhub's global partner network of gyms, studios and wellness businesses. The Senior Manager, Partner Marketing (France & Benelux) leads Partner Marketing strategy and execution for these markets, as part of Wellhub's regional EU Partner Marketing team.

This person will act as the regional Point of Contact (POC) for Partner Marketing in France and Benelux, owning the local Business-to- Partner value proposition, brand positioning, network growth and engagement and, fitness industry events, working closely with Partnerships, local and cross-functional Marketing, Wellbeing Engagement, Product Development and Revenue teams to align strategy and execution. Reporting to the Partner Marketing Director, EU, this role combines strategic ownership of the region with hands-on execution.

This role directly impacts the growth and satisfaction of Wellhub's partner network in France and Benelux, contributing to the team's broader goals around partner network growth, partner engagement, and partner satisfaction (PSAT).

 

YOUR IMPACT

  • Market-Specific Value Proposition: Develop and implement the local Business to Partner value proposition across all partner-facing materials and touchpoints for France and Benelux.
  • Brand Awareness & Positioning: Build Wellhub's presence and credibility within the regional fitness industry through relationships with industry associations/alliances, sponsorships, events, media/publications, and key opinion leaders (KOLs).
  • Strategic Partner Growth (B2P2C): Lead go-to-market strategy for partner launches, relaunches, and dedicated campaigns and promotions to end users and clients, driving growth with existing partners.
  • Strategic Partner Engagement: Build partner trust through structured engagement initiatives, including fitness industry events, partner conferences and summits.
  • Network Growth Support: Support the Demand Generation team's strategy with local market insights and develop sales enablement materials to drive growth across the partner network.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Partnerships,  User Growth, Corporate communication, Content, Revenue teams local and global level to align initiatives with company-wide strategy.
  • Budget Ownership: Manage the regional Partner Marketing budget for France and Benelux, allocating resources across campaigns, events and other marketing initiatives to drive results and maximize ROI.
  • Data-Driven Marketing: Use performance data and partner insights to inform, prioritize and continuously optimize Partner Marketing initiatives in the region.
  • AI-Driven Productivity: Autonomously identify and apply AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to raise the team's level of automation — streamlining repetitive tasks, accelerating content, reporting and campaign production, and embedding AI-assisted workflows into day-to-day ways of working. Continuously build personal AI fluency and share practices that help the broader team work smarter.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Native/fluent in French and fluent in English, based in France with deep knowledge of local market and fitness industry culture.
  • Working knowledge of Dutch is a plus, given the scope across Benelux markets.
  • [+8] years of experience in Marketing, ideally with exposure to Partner, Channel, Product or Revenue Marketing in a B2B or B2B2C environment.
  • Proven ability to build value propositions, brand positioning and go-to-market strategies, and to execute them independently as a regional lead.
  • Comfortable managing institutional relationships with industry KOLs, associations and strategic partners.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Data-driven approach to marketing decisions, comfortable with CRM and marketing analytics tools.
  • Fluent English is mandatory.

We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that native/fluent French, prior Marketing experience, and English proficiency are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

 

Your Team and Role

As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow.

 

Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/

 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands

  • Demonstrable track record of building and scaling complex and established systems

  • Ability to lead the future of our design system, from audit, recommending solutions, and planning their rollout via quick wins or large-scale projects

  • Ability to communicate recommendations and prioritization with clear documentation, success metrics, resources, and rationale which stakeholders, designers, and engineers can confidently act on

  • A knack for balancing structure with scale by creating frameworks (tokens, libraries) that hold up across platforms and teams without sacrificing craft

  • Deep knowledge of design tools, such as Figma, that are key to evolving and maintaining the design system

  • Experience bridging design and engineering practices, including creating shared nomenclature and workflows that map across tools and platforms

  • Accustomed to applying agentic and AI-driven solutions into design system management and maintenance workflows, to both accelerate and elevate how the system scales

  • Enjoy pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality

  • Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale

  • Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics

  • Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

 

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

 

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

À propos du poste

En tant que Business Development Representative chez Amenitiz, vous prenez en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact de prospection jusqu'à la signature du contrat. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste centré uniquement sur la prise de rendez-vous. Vous prospectez, réalisez des démonstrations, traitez les objections et concluez les ventes, tout en gérant votre pipeline et votre contribution au chiffre d'affaires de bout en bout.

Nos clients sont des hôteliers indépendants partout en Europe : des établissements familiaux, des hôtels-boutiques et de petites chaînes hôtelières insuffisamment servis par des solutions technologiques conçues pour les grands groupes. Avec plus de 15 000 clients et une note de satisfaction de 4,8/5, notre produit bénéficie d'une forte reconnaissance sur le marché.

Vous commercialiserez une solution qui a un impact concret et mesurable sur le quotidien de ses utilisateurs, tout en étant pleinement responsable de l'ensemble du processus qui leur permet d'y accéder.

(Ce rôle est basé à Lyon, en France)

Votre mission

  • Prospection et génération de pipeline

  • Gestion des objections et closing

  • Traitez avec assurance les hésitations, les comparaisons avec la concurrence et les objections liées au timing. Créez un sentiment d'urgence lorsque cela est pertinent et sachez demander la signature.

  • Maintenez HubSpot à jour et garantissez la fiabilité des données. Réalisez des prévisions précises et assurez un suivi rigoureux de chaque opportunité.

  • Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables commerciaux et vos collègues afin d'améliorer en continu votre approche. Partagez les retours du marché, les objections récurrentes et les informations concurrentielles pour contribuer à la performance collective.

Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale. You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.


Your responsibilities

  • Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

  • Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

  • Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

  • Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

  • Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

  • Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

  • Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

Tools we use

  • Amplitude, SQL, Looker

  • Figma

  • Notion

  • Slack

  • Enterpret

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

  • You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

  • You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

  • You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

  • You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

  • You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

  • You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

  • You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

  • Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

  • Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

  • Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

  • Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

  • Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

  • Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

  • Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

  • Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

  • Own the strategy and key initiatives for your product area end to end

  • Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

  • Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

  • Use data, user insight, and experimentation to decide what to scale, iterate, stop, or explore next

  • Raise the bar on product thinking, experimentation, and decision-making across Yubo

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition

  • First interview with Sacha, our CEO

  • Product case study and debrief with Product Managers

  • Cultural fit assessments

  • And if everything went well, an offer!

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A hybrid work policy with up to two days of on-site presence per week at an amazing office and monthly team events to enjoy.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

Nous sommes fiers d’être une entreprise qui prospère en faisant les choses différemment, en remettant en question les attentes et les stéréotypes tout en ayant un impact positif sur la vie de nos clients.

Rejoignez-nous chez Lovehoney, où le plaisir s’allie à la créativité, aux données et à l’innovation !


Missions et Responsabilités

Nous recherchons, dans le cadre d'un CDD de remplacement temporaire,  un/e Category Manager  pour rejoindre notre équipe et prendre en charge la qualité, l’enrichissement et la performance de nos fiches produits sur nos deux sites e-commerce : espaceplaisir et SexyAvenue.

Vous n'êtes pas simplement en charge des fiches produit : vous êtes celui ou celle qui garantit que chaque produit est complet, bien présenté et connecté aux bons produits complémentaires sur Magento. Vous êtes garant(e) de la qualité des données produit, de la pertinence des associations cross-sell et de l'impact éditorial des fiches produit sur l'ensemble des sites (espaceplaisir, SexyAvenue), avec un objectif clair : maximiser la conversion et le panier moyen.

2. Copywriting & contenus produit

3. Cross-sell & merchandising produit 

→  Définir et paramétrer les associations de cross-sell et d'upsell sur les fiches produit

→  Analyser la performance des cross-sell et ajuster les recommandations produit 

→  Collaborer avec l'E-Merchandising Manager sur le tri et la mise en avant des produits associés 

 


Profil recherché

Compétences techniques 

→  Maîtrise de Magento 2 (thème Hyvä) ou autre CMS — compétence indispensable 

→  Excellente maîtrise rédactionnelle en français, sens du storytelling produit 

→  Bonne compréhension des logiques de cross-sell et de merchandising produit 

→  Anglais professionnel indispensable (échanges réguliers avec les équipes groupe) 

→  Solides bases en SEO (recherche de mots-clés, bonnes pratiques on-page) 

→  Orienté(e) résultats : chaque action doit être mesurée et évaluée à l'aune de son impact sur la performance 

Compétences comportementales 

→  Rigueur, sens du détail et respect des délais de production 

→  Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main rapidement un nouvel outil (Magento) 

→  Aisance dans le travail transverse (E-Merchandising Manager, SEO, CRO) 

→  Curiosité pour les enjeux e-commerce et data

Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ What is at stake in the coming months

  • Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

  • Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

  • Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 Your mission

  • Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

  • Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

  • Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

  • Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

  • Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

  • Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

  • Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

  • Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 How you will be measured

  • First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

  • 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

  • 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 This job is your dream job if:

  • You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

  • You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

  • You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

  • You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

  • You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 This job is not for you if:

  • You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

  • You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

Join us as a Data Analyst – Growth to own how Qonto measures whether its marketing spend actually works. You'll take charge of our attribution models and incrementality tests — geo tests, conversion lift studies — turning marketing spend across channels into evidence-backed decisions, under the guidance of Clotilde Pety, our Lead Data Analyst.

  • Own attribution, end to end — maintain the attribution models and touchpoint definitions, and be the go-to when a stakeholder asks why the numbers moved.
  • Test where it matters, inside the ad platforms — design and run geo tests and conversion lift studies directly in Google Ads and Meta Ads.

Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The internship

You'll shape how Homa communicates, inside and out. You'll operate at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and AI, turning complex ideas into sharp content that lands with every audience: talent, game studios, partners, investors, and our own teams. There's no shadow work. What you create will be published, presented, and read. You'll develop a 360° understanding of Homa by working with every function, while building your writing, design, and AI skills.

What you'll do

  • Build. Design AI-powered content systems (workflows, prompt libraries, templates) so the team can produce more, faster, without losing quality.
  • Create. Produce high-impact content fast: LinkedIn posts, blog articles, employer branding, internal decks, and strategic presentations.
  • Produce. Use AI tools for images, video, and copy to create high-performing creatives and content for our games.
  • Monitor trends. Track social media trends, competitor content, and new AI tools to stay ahead.
  • Elevate. Spot high-impact opportunities, introduce better formats and tools, and raise the bar for how Homa informs, inspires, and engages.

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
  • Real ownership, early. Your projects will change how Homa operates, and you'll see the results.
  • Learn from leadership. You'll work alongside leaders and people who make decisions.
  • A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.
  • AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works.

Requirements

  • Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes, when something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain something complex in a few sentences.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
  • Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this internship as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
  • Bonus: you've built something. A game, an app, a student initiative, a side business. We'd love to hear about it.

For this role, you'll also bring:

  • You've created content in some form: a blog, a TikTok page, a newsletter, a portfolio, a standout university project. Show us. We care about what you've made, not where you made it.
  • Sharp writing. You write and speak with clarity and punch, adapt to any audience, and work confidently with anyone.
  • Design instinct. You're fluent in content tools (slides, Canva, Figma, or similar) and build clean, high-quality visuals.

Practical details

  • A 6-month internship, with a flexible start date. We adapt to any month.
  • A convention de stage (internship agreement) is required.
  • Apprenticeships (alternance) are also welcome.
  • Paris based. You'll need to be able to work onsite at our Paris office.
  • Fluent English is required. French is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Top performers may be offered a full-time role at the end of the internship

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: this role is based out of the EMEA territory, specifically London, UK.

Regional Expectations

  • Based in an EMEA time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a strong plus.

German Language Expectations

  • Native-level or full professional fluency in German (written and spoken), with the ability to conduct complex sales conversations and negotiations.

Opportunity

Deepgram is looking for an Account Executive to drive new customers and revenue to our rapidly growing company, specifically in the German markets. You will have the opportunity to sell a patented world-class voice AI platform that has been enabling our customers to achieve things previously not attainable. We are looking for hungry and talented sales professionals to help us take our top-line revenue to new heights!

What You'll Do

  • Self-prospecting to build a strong sales pipeline of new logos, striving to exceed quarterly and annual sales targets, as well as partnering with the Marketing and SDR teams to generate meetings

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (especially Sales Ops and Sales Engineers) to ensure sales effectiveness

  • Have a depth of understanding regarding customer needs in the voice AI space, competition, and Deepgram products to be able to articulate Deepgram’s value proposition fully to highly technical buyers

  • Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, work with CSMs to drive upsell opportunities and manage existing accounts ongoing

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Value having leadership that has tenure and a track record of success

  • Thrive working with A Players as cross-functional partners across GTM

  • Understand the importance of selling a product that is market validated and can deliver on its technical promise

  • Believe there should be no cap to upside and want control of account up-sell potential

  • Are passionate about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech

It’s Important to Us That You Have

  • Proven experience in a technical full-cycle sales role

  • Experience building your own pipeline from scratch and closing accounts

  • Consistent overachievement against sales targets in past experiences

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Empathy and a unique ability to understand customer needs

  • Highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills due to managing multiple opportunities at any given time

  • Ability to drive a consistent and repeatable sales process with a coachable/adaptable mindset based on other rep success.

  • It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Familiarity with Challenger or Triangle sales methodology

  • Experience selling to a technical audience in a similar space

  • Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI/ML technologies.

  • Fluency in German, French, Dutch, or other major regional languages.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to -----

About Us

ten23 health is a human-centric and sustainable strategic partner of choice for the pharmaceutical industry and biotech start-ups for the development, manufacture, and testing of tomorrow’s medicines. We support our clients in developing differentiated, stable, usable, and safe injectable treatments for patients.


Your mission

We are looking for a Senior Automation & OT Engineer to develop our automation strategy while ensuring the day-to-day reliability, compliance, and continuous improvement of the operational technology running our production equipment. Sitting at the intersection of automation engineering and IT operations, you will lead complex projects and act as the primary technical expert for the shop floor. You will balance hands-on troubleshooting of PLCs and servers with structured, GMP-compliant change management to support safe, efficient manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Leadership: Co - develop and support the site's overall automation strategy. Manage project pipelines, budgets, CAPEX/OPEX engineering tasks, and end-to-end hardware/software lifecycle planning.

SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You own the code that runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable.
  • B-rep and Mesh Depth. You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.
  • Kernel Fluency. Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes.
  • Technical Excellence. Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python for rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write and test performant code. 
  • Manufacturing Instinct. Some knowledge of fabrication techniques-casting, stamping, composites, and additive manufacturing-alongside toolsets for evaluating design manufacturability, risk profiles, quality standards, and cost factors.
  • End-to-End Ownership. Algorithm design through to a shipped, tested, maintained service.
  • First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you know whether the bug is in the code, the model, or the assumption.
  • Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.
  • Maniacal Urgency. Speed is our only edge. You thrive in the "chaos-to-order" phase of a startup.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship.
  • CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them.
  • Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll go find it.
  • People who treat "it works on the test model" as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job.
  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich.


Apply

Resume: Focus on geometry systems you've built and owned.
GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hard problem you solved - code, papers, or parts that came off a machine because of you.
Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

data.title: (Senior) Sales Manager Schweiz (m|w|d) | Marktexpansion SaaS Full Service Lösung

data.description:
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

 

Responsibilities

  • Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

  • MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

  • Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

  • BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

  • High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

  • EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

  • Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

  • Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

  • Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

  • Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

  • Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design: gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

  • Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification): ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

  • Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

  • Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

  • Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

  • Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

  • English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
